Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Large Windowpane Footed Stoneware Planter, 9.25"H, Arabesque
Colors: Arabesque
Materials: Ceramic
This beautiful arabesque-colored planter with a large hand-stenciled pattern will brighten any room. Slight variations from one pot to the next truly make each pot unique. Durable and easily cleaned, this large planter will hold lovely spring blooms—or whatever else you want to plant! 9" diameter x 9.25"H; 8.25" interior diameter Made of ceramic stoneware for durability Equipped with a drainage hole, this pot is suitable for direct or indirect planting. Criss-cross pattern is applied by hand to create a one-of-a-kind look. No assembly required Hand wash with a damp cloth.
